subject: System Design
title: API Rate Limiting and Throttling
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: API Rate Limiting and Throttling.

hook.text: An API serves 100,000 requests per second. A single rogue client sends 50,000 of them.

buildup.text: Rate limiting caps requests per client per time window. Throttling slows down excess requests gracefully.

discovery.text: HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) tells clients to back off. Retry-After headers say when to try again.

twist.text: Distributed rate limiting across multiple servers requires shared state, adding latency and complexity.

climax.text: Rate limiting protects both the system and fair access for all clients.

punchline.text: Limit requests per client to protect everyone's access.

quiz.question: What HTTP status code indicates rate limiting?
